own_solution.law: For an ideal LC circuit, omega_0 = 1/sqrt(LC) and f_0 = 1/(2*pi*sqrt(LC)). Here LC = 1.0e-6 s^2, so omega_0 = 1000 rad/s and f_0 = 159.154943 Hz.
assumptions: The circuit is modeled using ideal lumped inductance and capacitance, with negligible losses and parasitic effects.
The separate, isolated resonator B is understood to have negligible coupling to circuit A.

notes: All four variants yield approximately 159 Hz. Resonator B's frequency is structurally disconnected under the intended independent-resonator interpretation. Strictly, electrical isolation alone does not exclude magnetic coupling; negligible coupling is the standard interpretation of the separate resonator elsewhere in the lab.
